howPage.title: How to Order
howPage.intro: Shopping at TechRevive is assisted by our team on WhatsApp. There is no cart or upfront payment: you pay only after stock is confirmed.

Click Check stock & order, then enter your name, WhatsApp number and area. WhatsApp opens with a prefilled message.
Our team checks stock with the supplier, then sends the final price and unit condition. The price is locked for 24 hours.

faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.intro: Quick answers to the most common questions. Can't find yours? Contact us on WhatsApp.
faqPage.stillAskDesc: Our team replies within 15 minutes during business hours.

items.q: Is there a warranty or can I return an item?
items.a: No. Our suppliers offer no warranty or returns, so TechRevive cannot either. That is why we describe each unit's condition, grade and flaws honestly before you pay.
Pick a product and click Check stock & order. Enter your name, WhatsApp number and delivery area. You will be taken to WhatsApp with a prefilled message and our team continues the confirmation.

items.q: Why does a product say 'Check Availability'?
items.a: We hold no stock of our own. This status means availability has not yet been confirmed with the supplier. We never write 'Ready Stock' until it is certain.

items.q: How long is the price locked?
items.a: Once we send the final price it is locked for 24 hours. After that the quote expires and the price may change.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Bank transfer, virtual account and QRIS. Payment is requested only after stock is confirmed and you accept the quote.

items.q: How does delivery work and what does it cost?
items.a: We serve Jabodetabek. Items are hand-delivered by our team or sent by courier as agreed. The fee and estimate are shared at confirmation.

items.q: What do Grade A, B and C mean?
items.a: Grade A: mint. Grade B: normal wear with light scratches. Grade C: visible cosmetic flaws but works normally. Battery health is listed where applicable.

items.q: How can I track my order?
items.a: Open the Track Order page and enter your inquiry code (starting with TR-) and the WhatsApp number you used to order.
Your name and WhatsApp number are used only to process your request and are never shared with third parties.
